report.title: Detector-control sweep: plant a known-broken state and require every gate to fire
report.question: For each gate, does a deliberately planted defect of the exact class the gate claims to detect make it turn RED - and does the gate stay GREEN on the unmodified tree, then return to GREEN after the mutation is reverted?
report.answer: SUCCESS:AUD-0046 emitted only when the artifact at output_path exists, is non-empty, parses against output_schema, and both named probes are recorded with their verbatim output. On this worktree .github/workflows is absent (14/14 inventoried CI jobs have YAML on disk). Isolated scratch detector-control ran 6 live gates: 4 FIRED (green/unmodified, red/mutated, green/reverted), 1 DISARMED (V-FIELDS silent under bare CI argv, fires with --require-complete), 1 SILENT-IN-BOTH (always-zero negative control). Remaining CI jobs are NOT-CHECKED because their workflow files and package trees are not present. Live tree was never mutated.
